# Support

Chiselo is an early open-source preview project.

For public help:

- open a bug report for reproducible failures;
- open a feature request for product ideas;
- attach a minimal HTML file when the issue is about layout editing;
- include screenshots for UI or export quality problems.

For private security concerns, see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

Community support is provided through GitHub issues. The project does not
currently offer a commercial support program.
